projects.title: E-commerce Payment Exceptions and Delivery Delay Detection
projects.description: Historical order and payment data replayed through Kafka, transformed in Databricks, and checked for payment exceptions and delivery delays.
bullets: Replayed historical e-commerce order and payment records through Kafka using Python and stored the events in Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
Developed PySpark transformations in Azure Databricks to update Delta tables, aggregating order charges and payments separately before comparing totals.
Generated order-level exception records in SQL for missing payments, amount differences and late deliveries, including exception reasons and delay durations.
Orchestrated processing and validation with Apache Airflow, comparing record counts and monetary totals after reruns to identify missing or duplicated records.

projects.title: Stock Price Error Detection and Investment Report Validation
projects.description: Historical stock-price data and sample holdings loaded into Snowflake, with checks on price records and investment-report totals.
bullets: Built an Airflow workflow to ingest historical stock-price files into ADLS Gen2 and load Snowflake tables using external stages and COPY INTO.
Modelled daily prices and sample holdings separately, using SQL joins and aggregations to calculate the value of sample holdings and investment-report totals.
Implemented SQL checks for duplicate prices, invalid price relationships and unmatched holdings, identifying affected securities before report generation.
Verified report totals against independently calculated test cases and produced validation summaries linking failed checks to affected securities and sample holdings.

projects.title: Cloud and AI Cost Validation with Budget Checks
projects.description: Azure billing exports reconciled in SQL, with AI request-cost estimates kept separate and budget thresholds checked.
bullets: Built an Airflow-scheduled Python workflow to load Azure billing exports into SQL tables and incorporate revised charges into cost records.
Created SQL cost summaries by resource, service and project tag, reconciling allocated and unallocated charges with source export totals.
Recorded AI application requests, model names and token usage to estimate costs from versioned rates, keeping these estimates separate from exported billing charges.
Implemented budget-threshold checks and alert records, testing threshold crossings and rerun behaviour with documented scenarios.

projects.title: Automated Invoice Processing and Data Quality Checks
projects.description: Python invoice processing with SQL discrepancy checks, payment reconciliation and email alerts for exceptions.
bullets: Developed Python scripts to process invoice records and check for missing, inconsistent or incorrect values.
Built SQL discrepancy checks to identify inconsistencies in invoice data before financial reporting.
Reconciled invoice and payment records to identify unmatched entries and other exceptions.
Implemented automated email alerts to flag validation failures and reconciliation exceptions.

projects.title: Hospital Patient Admission and Billing Process Analysis
projects.description: Admission and billing workflows mapped from current to proposed processes, supported by requirements documents and a Power BI dashboard.
projects.output: Process maps, requirements documents and a KPI dashboard
bullets: Mapped AS-IS and TO-BE workflows in Lucidchart for patient onboarding, insurance-claim validation and billing.
Prepared a Business Requirements Document (BRD) and Functional Specification Document (FSD) covering functional scope, proposed EMR integration and billing-workflow automation.
Used fishbone diagrams and the 5 Whys to analyse causes of claim rejections and propose validation checkpoints in the target workflow.
Developed a Power BI dashboard covering average wait time, admission cycle time, billing turnaround and claim approval rate.

projects.title: Vehicle Service Workflow and Automation Design
projects.description: A service-booking, technician-dispatch and billing workflow explored through process maps, customer journeys, user stories and data design.
projects.output: Target workflows, Jira stories and a documented data model
bullets: Used Value Stream Mapping to identify bottlenecks in booking, servicing and billing, and propose a simpler target process.
Created personas and customer journey maps to examine user pain points in technician dispatch and customer feedback.
Documented epics and user stories in Jira during an Agile simulation for scheduling and notification modules.
Designed a data dictionary and entity-relationship (ER) diagram to document data structures for requirements handoff.

projects.title: E-commerce Conversion Prediction and Pricing Analysis
projects.description: Conversion modelling, customer segmentation and pricing analysis used to examine sales, profitability and customer behaviour.
projects.output: Conversion-model evaluation, customer segments and pricing comparisons
bullets: Prepared and analysed e-commerce data with pandas and NumPy to examine conversion patterns and pricing variables.
Built a logistic regression model for conversion prediction and evaluated predictions using F1-score.
Compared pricing scenarios using sales, profitability, revenue and return-on-investment measures to assess trade-offs.
Applied clustering to group customers by shared characteristics and behaviours for segment-level analysis.

projects.title: Fraud Detection in Financial Transactions
projects.description: Compared classifiers on imbalanced transaction data and evaluated predictions using precision, recall and F1-score.
bullets: Built and compared Random Forest and Logistic Regression classifiers in scikit-learn to distinguish fraudulent transactions from legitimate transactions.
Prepared transaction features with pandas, applied feature scaling and used SMOTE from imbalanced-learn during model training to address class imbalance.
Evaluated model predictions using precision, recall and F1-score to compare fraud-classification performance.
projects.output: Classifier comparison using precision, recall and F1-score

intro: I'm Vedant Kulkarni. I build and maintain Azure data pipelines, transform e-commerce, CRM and payment data with SQL, Python and PySpark, and investigate data discrepancies.
intro_support: I work with developers and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, define transformation rules and validate outputs. My projects also cover process mapping, data modelling and workflow design.

approach: Clarify what a report or process needs to show, identify the data involved, and agree the rules and checks with stakeholders.
Review schemas, keys and record relationships; check for missing, duplicated or inconsistent values before deciding how to transform the data.
Define source-to-target mappings, data models and processing steps. Use process maps or requirements documents where the task also involves a workflow change.
Use SQL, Python and PySpark to implement transformations, reconcile records and totals, and investigate failed loads or validation checks.
Deliver results that can be checked.
Prepare reporting datasets, dashboards and exception summaries, with transformation rules and validation findings documented so others can review and use the output.
